facts.fact: Blair 撞见：本该在浴室的 Louise 站在 Cassie 房里——右手握着那本日记。
facts.anchor: And as she studies the article from earlier, I notice something in her right hand.

facts.fact: 她平静认领：「看来你们找到了我的日记。」
facts.anchor: ‘I see you found my journal,’ Louise says, her voice calm and collected.

facts.fact: 她点破：厨房那场「警匪剧式审讯」很聪明——但你还没拼完。
facts.anchor: Blair, you seem smart. I could tell by your police procedural interrogation in the kitchen.

facts.fact: 版本修正：跑是真的、崩溃是真的——只是省略了原因。
facts.anchor: ‘I did run. I did have a breakdown…but I just left out why.

facts.fact: 炸弹三：I knew him too——过去式！她知道 George 已经死了。
她回来的目的：不是重逢——是要 Cassie 亲口说出 George 到底怎么了。
Blair 的惊觉回放：石英、猫、尸体、地毯——明明那么小心、那么黑。
facts.anchor: The rose quartz. The cat. The body. The carpet.

facts.fact: Blair 顶罪：人是我杀的——最后一次问你：你想要什么？
facts.anchor: ‘It was me. I killed him. So, I’ll ask you for the last time – what do you want?’

facts.fact: 章尾：壶再烧上——「我们从头讲起吧」。
facts.anchor: I think we should start from the beginning.
